description: The null3D rules for an AI agent, checked before each command and each file edit.

hooks.command: d=$PWD; while [ ! -f "$d/.agent/agent-hook.mjs" ] && [ "$d" != "/" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; node "$d/.agent/agent-hook.mjs" bash
d=$PWD; while [ ! -f "$d/.agent/agent-hook.mjs" ] && [ "$d" != "/" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; node "$d/.agent/agent-hook.mjs" edit
